name: Ottersheim bei Landau (Germany)
description: Quartered red and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ottersheim bei Landau (a lozengy field, a crossbow and a ring with a star).
history: Municipal flag of Ottersheim bei Landau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ottersheim arms — lozengy, crossbow and ring
